lead: Kapil Dev is best known as an Indian cricketer, born on 6 January 1959 in Chandigarh.
As of 2026, he is 67 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Haryana cricket team and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
This profile collects the Kapil facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
